spec.description: Vendor-inspired drilling fleet cards backed only by public.machine_event evidence.
One clickable card per selected machine. Values come only from public.machine_event; missing fields remain N/A and historical errors are not labelled active.

spec.rawSql:
SET jit = off;
/* REALTIME DRILLING FLEET OPERATIONS - DYNAMIC TIME-WINDOW KPI (ULTRAFAST INDEX-SEEK) */
WITH RECURSIVE all_eqp AS (
   (SELECT equipment_id FROM public.machine_event ORDER BY equipment_id LIMIT 1)
   UNION ALL
   SELECT (SELECT equipment_id FROM public.machine_event WHERE equipment_id > t.equipment_id ORDER BY equipment_id LIMIT 1)
   FROM all_eqp t
   WHERE t.equipment_id IS NOT NULL
),
latest_per_eqp AS (
  SELECT e.equipment_id, me.*
  FROM all_eqp e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT event_type, event_code, event_message, event_time, spindle, id
    FROM public.machine_event m
    WHERE m.equipment_id = e.equipment_id
      AND $__timeFilter(m.event_time)
    ORDER BY m.event_time DESC, m.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) me
  WHERE e.equipment_id IS NOT NULL
),
window_tool_events AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS tool_event_count
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND (event_type = 'TOOL_CHANGE' OR event_code IN ('0417', '0214', '0215', '0110', '0408'))
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    l.equipment_id,
    l.event_type,
    l.event_code,
    l.event_message,
    l.event_time,
    l.spindle,
    l.id,
    p.prog,
    rf.rpm,
    rf.feed,
    h.holes,
    CASE 
      WHEN l.event_code = '0408' THEN 'BIT BROKEN'
      WHEN l.event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E') THEN 'ALARM'
      WHEN l.event_type = 'STOP' OR l.event_code = '0108' THEN 'STOP'
      WHEN l.event_type = 'TOOL_CHANGE' OR l.event_code = '0110' THEN 'TOOL_CHANGE'
      WHEN l.event_type = 'PROGRAM_LOAD' OR l.event_code = '0103' THEN 'FINISHED'
      ELSE 'RUN'
    END AS "StateLabel",
    CASE 
      WHEN l.event_code = '0408' THEN 'alarm'
      WHEN l.event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E') THEN 'alarm'
      WHEN l.event_type = 'STOP' OR l.event_code = '0108' THEN 'stop'
      WHEN l.event_type = 'TOOL_CHANGE' OR l.event_code = '0110' THEN 'warning'
      WHEN l.event_type = 'PROGRAM_LOAD' OR l.event_code = '0103' THEN 'finished'
      ELSE 'run'
    END AS "StateClass"
  FROM latest_per_eqp l
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT (regexp_match(event_message, '(?i)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.tlp)'))[1] AS prog
    FROM public.machine_event me
    WHERE me.equipment_id = l.equipment_id
      AND me.event_time <= to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0)
      AND (me.event_code IN ('0101', '0103') OR me.event_message LIKE '%.tlp%')
    ORDER BY me.event_time DESC, me.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) p ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
      ROUND((regexp_match(event_message, '(?i)\[Rpm\]:[^>]+->[[:space:]]*([0-9.]+)'))[1]::numeric)::text || 'k' AS rpm,
      ROUND((regexp_match(event_message, '(?i)\[Feed\]:[^>]+->[[:space:]]*([0-9.]+)'))[1]::numeric, 1)::text AS feed
    FROM public.machine_event me
    WHERE me.equipment_id = l.equipment_id
      AND me.event_time <= to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0)
      AND me.event_code = '0109'
    ORDER BY me.event_time DESC, me.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) rf ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
      to_char((regexp_match(event_message, '(?i)(?:at hole|Hole:|start:)[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)'))[1]::bigint, 'FM999,999,999') || ' (' ||
      CASE 
        WHEN event_code = '0110' THEN 'Tool Change'
        WHEN event_code = '0108' THEN 'Machine Stop'
        WHEN event_code IN ('0417', '0120') THEN 'Tool is Broken'
        WHEN event_code = '0112' THEN 'Cycle Start'
        ELSE 'Running'
      END || ')' AS holes
    FROM public.machine_event me
    WHERE me.equipment_id = l.equipment_id
      AND me.event_time <= to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0)
      AND me.event_code IN ('0110', '0108', '0417', '0120', '0112')
      AND me.event_message ~* '(?i)(?:at hole|Hole:|start:)[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)'
    ORDER BY me.event_time DESC, me.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) h ON true
),
calculated AS (
  SELECT 
    c.equipment_id AS "Machine",
    c."StateLabel",
    c."StateClass",
    COALESCE(
      CASE 
        WHEN c.event_code ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND (c.event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E') OR c.event_code = '0408') THEN 'E-' || c.event_code
        WHEN c.event_code ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND c.event_type IN ('RUN', 'M', 'EVENT', 'TOOL_CHANGE', 'PROGRAM_LOAD', 'STOP') THEN 'M-' || c.event_code
        WHEN c.event_code ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN 'M-' || c.event_code
        ELSE c.event_code
      END, 'N/A'
    ) AS "Code",
    COALESCE(c.event_message, 'Normal execution') AS "Message",
    CASE
      WHEN c.event_message ~* 'T[0-9]+' AND c.event_message ~* 'C[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?' THEN
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, '(T[0-9]+)', 'i'))[1]) || ' (' || 
        (regexp_match(c.event_message, 'C([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', 'i'))[1] || 'mm)'
      WHEN c.event_message ~* '->[[:space:]]*T[1-9][0-9]*M[0-9]+' THEN
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, '->[[:space:]]*(T[0-9]+)', 'i'))[1]) || ' (' || 
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, '->[[:space:]]*T[0-9]+(M[0-9]+)', 'i'))[1]) || ')'
      WHEN c.event_message ~* 'ATC[[:space:]]*T[1-9][0-9]*M[0-9]+' THEN
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, 'ATC[[:space:]]*(T[0-9]+)', 'i'))[1]) || ' (' || 
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, 'ATC[[:space:]]*T[0-9]+(M[0-9]+)', 'i'))[1]) || ')'
      WHEN c.event_message ~* '^(T[0-9]+)[[:space:]]+' THEN
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, '^(T[0-9]+)', 'i'))[1])
      WHEN c.event_message ~* '[[:<:]](T[0-9]{1,4})[[:>:]]' THEN
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, '[[:<:]](T[0-9]{1,4})[[:>:]]', 'i'))[1])
      ELSE 'N/A'
    END AS "ToolDia",
    COALESCE(c.spindle, 'SPINDLE_MAIN_1') AS "SpindleContext",
    to_char(c.event_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok', 'HH12:MI:SS AM') AS "LastTime",
    to_char(c.event_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "ObservedAt",
    CASE
      WHEN to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - c.event_time < INTERVAL '10 seconds' THEN 'Just now'
      WHEN to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - c.event_time < INTERVAL '1 minute' THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - c.event_time)))::TEXT || 's ago'
      WHEN to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - c.event_time < INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - c.event_time)) / 60)::TEXT || 'm ago'
      WHEN to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - c.event_time < INTERVAL '1 day' THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - c.event_time)) / 3600)::TEXT || 'h ago'
      ELSE ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - c.event_time)) / 86400)::TEXT || 'd ago'
    END AS "TimeAgo",
    COALESCE(c.holes, 'N/A') AS "Holes",
    COALESCE(c.prog, 'N/A') AS "Program",
    COALESCE(c.rpm, 'N/A') AS "RPM",
    COALESCE(c.feed, 'N/A') AS "FEED",
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS "TotalCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."StateClass" = 'run') OVER () AS "RunCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."StateClass" = 'stop') OVER () AS "StopCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."StateClass" = 'alarm') OVER () AS "AlarmCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."StateClass" = 'warning') OVER () AS "ToolChangeCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."StateClass" = 'finished') OVER () AS "FinishedCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.event_time < to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '5 minutes') OVER () AS "StaleCount",
    (SELECT tool_event_count FROM window_tool_events) AS "ToolCount",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'All' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterAll",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'RUN' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterRun",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'ALARM' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterAlarm",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'TOOL_CHANGE' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterTool",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'FINISHED' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterFinished",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'STOP' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterStop"
  FROM classified c
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM calculated
  WHERE (${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'All' 
     OR "StateLabel" = ${status_filter:sqlstring}
     OR (${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'ALARM' AND "StateClass" = 'alarm'))
    AND ('All' IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) OR "Machine" IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}))
    AND (${program_search:sqlstring} = '' OR "Program" ILIKE '%' || ${program_search:sqlstring} || '%')
),
fallback AS (
  SELECT 
    NULL::text AS "Machine",
    NULL::text AS "StateLabel",
    NULL::text AS "StateClass",
    NULL::text AS "Code",
    NULL::text AS "Message",
    NULL::text AS "ToolDia",
    NULL::text AS "SpindleContext",
    NULL::text AS "LastTime",
    NULL::text AS "ObservedAt",
    NULL::text AS "TimeAgo",
    NULL::text AS "Holes",
    NULL::text AS "Program",
    NULL::text AS "RPM",
    NULL::text AS "FEED",
    COALESCE((SELECT "TotalCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "TotalCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT "RunCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "RunCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT "StopCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "StopCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT "AlarmCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "AlarmCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT "ToolChangeCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "ToolChangeCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT "FinishedCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "FinishedCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT "StaleCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "StaleCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT tool_event_count FROM window_tool_events), 0::bigint) AS "ToolCount",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'All' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterAll",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'RUN' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterRun",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'ALARM' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterAlarm",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'TOOL_CHANGE' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterTool",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'FINISHED' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterFinished",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'STOP' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterStop"
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM filtered)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM filtered
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM fallback
ORDER BY "Machine" NULLS LAST;

options.content:
DRILLING — REALTIME OPERATIONS Dynamic Live

ภาพรวมสถานะการทำงานของเครื่องเจาะ (Drilling Fleet Status) แบบเรียลไทม์ ข้อมูลอัปเดตอัตโนมัติ พร้อมระบบแจ้งเตือน RUN / ALARM / STOP / WARNING
Filter: ALL ({{data.0.TotalCount}}) 🟢 RUN ({{data.0.RunCount}}) 🔴 ALARM ({{data.0.AlarmCount}}) 🟡 TOOL_CHANGE ({{data.0.ToolChangeCount}}) 🔵 FINISHED ({{data.0.FinishedCount}}) 🟠 STOP ({{data.0.StopCount}})
TOTAL MACHINES
{{data.0.TotalCount}}

{{data.0.RunCount}}

{{data.0.StaleCount}}

{{data.0.ToolCount}}

{{TimeAgo}}

{{/each}} {{else}}
ไม่พบเครื่องเจาะที่ส่งข้อมูลในช่วงเวลานี้
ไม่มีข้อมูล Event ตรงกับตัวกรองหรือช่วงเวลาที่เลือก คุณสามารถเลือกขยายช่วงเวลาใน Time Picker หรือคลิกปุ่ม Filter ด้านบนได้ทันที
{{/if}}

spec.__legacyStringValue:
WITH RECURSIVE t AS (
   (SELECT equipment_id FROM public.machine_event ORDER BY equipment_id LIMIT 1)
   UNION ALL
   SELECT (SELECT equipment_id FROM public.machine_event WHERE equipment_id > t.equipment_id ORDER BY equipment_id LIMIT 1)
   FROM t
   WHERE t.equipment_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value 
UNION ALL 
SELECT equipment_id AS __text, equipment_id AS __value 
FROM t WHERE equipment_id IS NOT NULL;
